title: The E-Bikes Don't Hibernate
why: Winter e-bike awareness for Midwest weekenders; depends on David confirming self-pickup winter rentals are really running.
hook_options: Kayaks are stacked. The e-bikes aren't.
Fat tires, frozen bay, nobody else.
Door County in January, by e-bike.
caption: The kayaks are stacked until May. Our fat-tire e-bikes are a different story. Self-pickup rentals run through winter, weather permitting. Go midday, layer up, stay off the ice. #doorcounty #winterbiking #ebike #fattirebike

slides.headline: The e-bikes don't hibernate.
slides.body: Kayaks are stacked until May. The fat-tire bikes stay out for self-pickup rentals, weather permitting.

slides.headline: Wide tires float where skinny ones sink.
slides.body: They grip packed snow and sandy shoulders better than a road bike. Still a bike, not a snowmobile.

slides.headline: A frozen bay with almost nobody around.
slides.body: This is Eagle Panorama in Peninsula State Park, shot on a winter ride. Summer, you'd wait for a spot.

slides.headline: Plan around a 4:30 sunset.
slides.body: December light goes early. Book a midday slot and you'll ride in the warmest part of the day.

slides.headline: Layer like it's 20 degrees colder.
slides.body: Wind off the lake bites at bike speed. Grippy gloves, a hat under the helmet, boots over sneakers.

slides.headline: Cave Point in snow is a different park.
slides.body: Same cliffs from the summer kayak photos, rimmed in ice. Park the bike and walk the shore.

slides.headline: Walk the rocks. Skip the shelf ice.
slides.body: Ice over open water isn't ground. Admire it from somewhere solid.

slides.headline: Self-pickup. Weather decides.
slides.body: Check the booking page for open days. Winter hours depend on the roads and the wind.

slides.headline: Fat tires. Frozen views. Early sunsets.
slides.body: Go midday, dress warmer than you think, and keep your boots off the ice.

slides.kicker: Save this for a winter weekend
slides.headline: Check winter rentals at doorcountykayaktours.com
slides.body: Send this to the friend with cabin fever.
